build.buildCommand: rm -f /tmp/railway-source.zip && for part in railway-bundle/part-*; do cat "$part" >> /tmp/railway-source.zip; done && rm -rf /tmp/nexustiers-source && unzip -oq /tmp/railway-source.zip -d /tmp/nexustiers-source && cp -a /tmp/nexustiers-source/nexustiers-railway/. . && corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build:railway
